description: Confirms that a newly created collection is usable: present in the schema, active, and readable with the current token, retrying once after waitTime milliseconds (default 2000) because Directus can lag a moment behind a create. Read-only. Use it right after create_collection and before writing items; refresh_collection_cache when it still reports the collection as missing, diagnose_collection_access for the full permission breakdown.

waitTime.description: Wait time in milliseconds before retry (default: 2000)

name: validate_collection_creation
